      S32K3 family of 32-bit automotive MCUs provides Arm® Cortex®-M7-based scalability for automotive general-purpose applications, including automotive zone controller and battery management system (BMS) design contexts. S32K3 supports single, dual and lockstep core configurations, 512 KB to 12 MB flash and ISO 26262 functional safety compliance up to ASIL D.

      S32K3 automotive MCUs integrate a hardware security engine (HSE), firmware over-the-air (FOTA) support and ISO 26262 compliant real-time drivers (RTD). The HSE supports AES-128/192/256, RSA, ECC, secure boot and key storage for automotive microcontroller security requirements.

      S32K3 compatibility with the NXP S32 Automotive Platform supports software reuse across body and vehicle control, zone control and electrification applications. S32K3 microcontrollers includes MAPBGA, LQFP and HDQFP package options, with HDQFP reducing package footprint by up to 55% versus a standard QFP package.

      Features

      Scalable MCU Platform

      • Single, multiple or lockstep Arm® Cortex®-M7 cores with floating-point unit (FPU), 120-320 MHz
      • 512 KB-12 MB Flash with ECC
      • Firmware over-the-air (FOTA) updates with A/B firmware swap, zero downtime, rollback support and automatic address
      • Analog-to-digital converter (ADC) and 16-bit eMIOS timers with Logic Control Unit for motor control
      • Low-power run and standby modes, fast wake-up, clock gating and power gating
      • LQFP, HDQFP and BGA package options
      • AEC-Q100 qualified Grade 1: -40 °C to 125 °C

      Functional Safety, Security and Automotive Connectivity

      • Functional safety support: ISO 26262 up to ASIL B/D
      • Fault Collection and Control Unit
      • Hardware and software watchdogs, plus clock, power and temperature monitors
      • Safety documentation and SafeAssure community support
      • Hardware Security Engine (HSE) with AES-128/192/256, RSA, ECC, secure boot, key storage, side-channel protection and ISO 21434 compliance
      • Automotive Ethernet and CAN connectivity, including time-sensitive networking (TSN), audio video bridging (AVB), 100 Mbps/1 Gbps Ethernet and Controller Area Network Flexible Data-Rate (CAN FD)
      • Flexible serial interfaces, including FlexIO support for Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI), Inter-Integrated Circuit (I²C), Inter-IC Sound (I²S) and Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT), plus serial audio interface and Quad Serial Peripheral Interface (QSPI)

      AUTOSAR and Production Software Support

      • S32 Design Studio integrated development environment (IDE) with Eclipse, GNU Compiler Collection (GCC), debugger and third-party support
      • Real-Time Drivers available free of charge for AUTOSAR and non-AUTOSAR applications, compliant with ASIL D
      • NXP-provided, field-upgradeable security firmware
      • S32 Safety Software Framework (SAF) and Structural Core Self-Test (SCST) library
      • Safety Peripheral Drivers
      • Model-Based Design Toolbox (MBDT) for MATLAB®
      • Inter-Platform Communication Framework (IPCF)

      Product Programs

      SafeAssure® (Functional Safety)

      When it comes to functional safety, NXP stands for quality, reliability, and ease of integration. Our SafeAssure program simplifies system-level safety implementation in accordance with the applicable safety standards.

      Product Longevity

      Participating products are available for a minimum of 10 years. Designated participating products developed for the automotive, telecom and medical segments are available for a minimum of 15 years.

      How NXP Uses Cookies

      When you visit any web site, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalised web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
      Privacy Policy

      Strictly Necessary Cookies

      Always Active

      These cookies are strictly necessary to provide you with services available through our websites and to use some of its features, such as access to secure areas. Because these cookies are strictly necessary to deliver the websites, you cannot refuse them without impacting how our websites function. You can block or delete them by changing your browser settings.

      Performance Cookies

      These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which information on pages is the most and least useful and see how visitors use site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

      Targeting Cookies

      These cookies are set by our advertising partners to enable personalized advertising and remarketing. They collect information about your browsing behavior across websites to build a profile of your interests. This profile is used to show you relevant ads on other websites and platforms. These cookies may also be used to measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns and limit the number of times you see an ad. These cookies are only activated if you give your explicit consent.
